header: Comparison bundles: passages from several Indo-European traditions
format: A slab holds comparison bundles. Each bundle names one pivot passage and partner passages from other branches (ids into 'passages'). A passage is a verse line, stanza, sentence or a window of a long sentence (role 'passage') with one unit of context on either side where the text has one. For every content word: its form, its corpus lemma, and the PIE lexicon etymon it maps to (id, reconstructed form, the lexicon's gloss; 'unmapped' if none). Mappings are automatic and can be wrong. Cite passages by their 'id' and claims by bundle. Passages marked research_only come from sources whose licence forbids commercial use or has not been checked.
